interpretation.capacity: No PPO or reward/observation/budget change; this study does not isolate neural capacity or justify a larger training budget as a solution.
interpretation.conditional_effects: H minus A isolates heading selection at actual origin. F minus H isolates origin selection at ideal heading. The effects are conditional dynamic policy interventions, not universal additive contributions; three arms cannot identify a full2x2 interaction.
interpretation.first_local_conflict: Hybrid first16m Walk fails the preserved local corridor without planned-origin control. The ideal-heading selection at actual origin is sufficient for this observed first-node regression under this frozen controller and case, not proof that every alternative ideal-heading controller must fail.
interpretation.gate_and_next: Inherited hybrid training gate FAIL. Keep PPO and Phase2.3 Final Runtime blocked. Prioritize an explicit task/reference-contract audit retaining the old local corridors and commanded-route geometry. Do not relabel failures or move scoring frames to obtain PASS; any later mechanism requires a new prospective experiment.
interpretation.no_tolerance_attribution: No early-stop tolerance-shortfall mechanism is asserted. Original target-distance termination and measured forward progress are retained.
interpretation.origin_tradeoff: Full planned origin adds the second16m Walk violation. Conditional origin selection improves final lateral and endpoint error on both sequences, while final absolute heading error is worse than hybrid on both. No component improves every metric.
interpretation.score_integrity: Actual node-start pose still determines all local errors and walk envelope violations. Selected control origin/heading and signed feedback terms independently reconstruct the applied command. These are retained legitimate task failures, not an evaluator missing-metric bug.
interpretation.statistics: All cases were previously seen. Primary78 and repeatability78 remain separate; deterministic repeatability is not fresh blind generalization, iid population evidence or a significance test.

repeatability.meaning: Deterministic replication, not independent statistical observations.

scope: Offline verification only; no model, physics, training, provider or outcome retry. Original sources, data, thresholds, labels and scores remain unchanged.
